description.en: Reserves a jump to another map at a given position, to happen after the current script finishes, optionally turning off the BGM for the transition.
ID of the map to jump to.
[x, y, z] position to place the player at on arrival.
Whether to turn off the BGM during the transition.
Likely true once the map jump was reserved; null if the call was invalid. The success value is produced by an internal reservation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Reserve a map jump to a specific map and position
CMND_RESERVE_MAP_JUMP(mapID, pos, bgmOff);
